# Company 069 — Usage Billing Infrastructure

**Company ID:** `company:future:069`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:069`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-069-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; no charging, invoicing, refunding, payment-method mutation or customer financial action.

## Business identity
Purpose: meter modern software/AI consumption and deterministically convert verified usage into pricing, balances, invoices, limits and revenue evidence.

## Product tree
Event Metering API; Usage Ledger; Meter/Dimension Registry; Aggregation Engine; Pricing Catalog; Tier/Volume/Graduated Rules; Credits/Prepaid Balances; Quotas/Caps; Minimum Commitments; Bundles; Trials/Promotions; Overage Engine; Entitlement Sync; Invoice Line Builder; Usage Dashboard; Customer Alerts; Forecasting; Billing Reconciliation; Revenue/Accounting Export; Webhooks; SDKs; Developer Portal; Enterprise Contract Rules; Multi-Currency/Tax Handoff; Private Deployment.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree
Features: event ID/idempotency, account/org/customer identity, meter/dimension/version, quantity/unit, timestamps, corrections, source/evidence, aggregation windows, pricing version, credits, commitments, caps, alerts, invoice periods, dispute/reconciliation and immutable adjustments.
Customers: SaaS, AI/API vendors, infrastructure companies, agent platforms, data products, marketplaces, developer tools and enterprises with internal chargeback/showback.
Verticals: tokens/models, API calls, compute, storage, bandwidth, documents, workflows, agents, devices, messages, minutes and transactions.

## Brain capability / architecture
Billing math and enforcement must be deterministic. Brain may explain bills, forecast spend, detect anomalies and suggest pricing changes but cannot invent meter events or alter charges. Architecture: append-only metering ledger, schema/version registry, stream/batch aggregation, pricing DSL, balance/credit ledger, invoice calculator, reconciliation, entitlement adapter, alerting, audit and protected financial actions.

## Agent tree
Meter Integrity Agent; Usage Anomaly Agent; Pricing Analyst; Forecast Agent; Reconciliation Agent; Invoice QA Agent; Customer Explanation Agent; Contract Configuration Agent; Revenue Ops Agent; Incident Agent.

## Deterministic services
Idempotent event ingest; meter schema validation; unit conversion; window aggregation; pricing functions; balance arithmetic; credit consumption; caps/quotas; late-event/correction handling; invoice calculation; immutable adjustments; reconciliation hashes.

## Workflow
Usage event → authenticate/source verify → idempotency/schema check → append ledger → aggregate → apply exact pricing version/contract → update credits/quotas → notify thresholds → period close → reconcile raw-to-aggregate-to-invoice → generate invoice lines/financial handoff → disputes/corrections via append-only adjustment → preserve evidence.

## Integrations / API / data
Applications, APIs, model gateways, cloud/compute systems, subscription/billing processors, accounting/ERP, tax engines, entitlement systems, data warehouses and notifications. Data: meters/events/aggregates/prices/contracts/credits/quotas/invoice lines/adjustments/reconciliation evidence.

## Monetization / distribution
Events/meters/customers/revenue volume, enterprise/private, developer plan, premium forecasting/reconciliation, managed implementation. Distribution via SaaS/AI developer ecosystems, billing/payment partners and FinOps/revenue-ops channels.

## Security/privacy/compliance
Financial integrity, signed/source-authenticated usage, tenant isolation, clock/timestamp controls, append-only adjustments, dual control for pricing changes, audit, tax handoff rather than unsupported tax advice, no hidden retroactive repricing.

## Failure / edge cases
Duplicate events, late events, clock skew, meter schema change, pricing version change mid-period, credits expiring, refunds, negative corrections, usage replay, provider outage, missing events, estimated usage, contract overrides, currency rounding, invoice dispute. Every correction must preserve lineage.

## Scale / overlap
Startup metering → enterprise billing → high-volume usage-finance infrastructure. Overlap #70 entitlements, #85 revenue leakage, #95 ROI. #069 owns measured usage→charge evidence.

## Classification
**DESIGN NOW:** stable event/idempotency IDs, append-only usage ledger, pricing/version identity, cost-center/meter dimensions, reconciliation.  
**BUILD NOW:** Command Center needs internal resource/cost telemetry and budgets even before customer billing; use compatible meter concepts now.  
**BUILD BEFORE FIRST COMPANY:** customer/tenant meter registry, pricing DSL, credits and billing reconciliation.  
**COMPANY-SPECIFIC LATER:** payment/invoice integrations and commercial pricing.  
**SCALE-ONLY:** massive streaming aggregation and multi-region billing ledgers.

# Mandatory 24-part completion block
1. Product Tree: metering/ledger/meters/aggregation/pricing/credits/quotas/commitments/bundles/trials/overage/entitlement/invoices/dashboard/alerts/forecast/reconcile/API.
2. Feature Tree: event/idempotency/customer/meter/unit/time/correction/evidence/window/price version/credits/caps/invoice/dispute.
3. Customer Tree: SaaS/AI/API/infra/agent/data/marketplace/devtools/internal chargeback.
4. Vertical Tree: tokens/API/compute/storage/bandwidth/docs/workflows/agents/devices/messages/minutes/transactions.
5. Brain Tree: explain/forecast/anomaly/recommend; math and charges deterministic.
6. Agent Tree: integrity/anomaly/pricing/forecast/reconcile/invoice QA/explanation/contracts/revenue ops/incident.
7. Service Tree: ingest/schema/units/aggregation/pricing/balances/credits/caps/corrections/invoices/hashes.
8. Workflow Tree: event→verify→ledger→aggregate→price→quota/alert→close→reconcile→invoice/adjust.
9. Integration Tree: apps/APIs/models/cloud/billing/accounting/tax/entitlements/warehouse/notifications.
10. Data Tree: meters/events/aggregates/prices/contracts/credits/quotas/invoice lines/adjustments.
11. API Tree: events/meters/usage/pricing/balance/forecast/invoice/reconcile.
12. Monetization Tree: events/meters/customers/volume/enterprise/private/managed.
13. Distribution Tree: SaaS/AI developer/billing/payment/FinOps/revenue ops.
14. Automation Tree: metering/aggregation/pricing/reconciliation automated; money movement separately protected.
15. Moat Tree: reliable event ledger, pricing DSL, correction/reconciliation engine, integrations.
16. Platform Tree: metering API→usage billing→revenue infrastructure.
17. Risk Tree: overcharge/undercharge/duplicates/missing events/rounding/retroactive rules/data leak.
18. Scale Tree: startup→enterprise→global high-volume ledger.
19. Spinoff Tree: pricing experimentation/credits/forecasting modules; entitlements and leakage remain separate.
20. Command Center Dependencies: event bus, IDs, financial governor, telemetry, tenant isolation, audit.
21. Design-Now Requirements: generic metering/cost-center/event lineage interfaces.
22. Build-Now Requirements: add resource/model/API usage telemetry compatible with future billing factory.
23. Safe-to-Defer Requirements: customer pricing/invoices/payment processors/tax/multi-region scale.
24. Autonomous Mature State: usage is metered, priced, reconciled and forecast automatically; humans approve pricing/contracts and financial exceptions.

## Saturation result
Further branches converge into entitlements, revenue leakage, pricing intelligence and payment systems already represented.

# Company 070 — Entitlement Management API

**Company ID:** `company:future:070`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:070`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-070-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; no customer provisioning, plan change, feature activation or account mutation.

## Business identity
Purpose: deterministically decide which customer, organization, user, device or agent may use which product feature, capacity, quota and contract benefit at a given moment.

## Product tree
Entitlement API; Plan/Feature Catalog; Organization/Account Hierarchy; Seat/Role Entitlements; Usage Quotas; Credits/Add-ons; Trials/Promotions; Enterprise Overrides; Grandfathering; Regional/Contract Rules; Beta/Feature Access; API/Developer Entitlements; Time-Bound Access; Delegated Admin; Provisioning/Revocation; Billing Sync; Feature-Flag Bridge; Audit/Explainability; SDKs; Edge Cache; Enterprise/Private Deployment; Migration/Versioning Tools.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree
Features: subject/account/org, product, plan/version, feature, resource scope, seat/role, limits, credits, effective/expiry, source contract/order, overrides, hierarchy inheritance, region, environment, beta cohort, usage state, decision reason, cache/version and audit.
Customers: SaaS, APIs, AI services, developer platforms, marketplaces, enterprise software, device/IoT vendors and multi-product companies.
Verticals: seat SaaS, usage-based AI/API, enterprise contracts, marketplace sellers/buyers, device fleets, multi-location businesses and internal platform services.

## Brain capability / architecture
Enforcement is deterministic. Brain may help configure complex contracts, explain entitlement conflicts and propose migration plans, but runtime allow/deny must come from versioned rules. Architecture: subject/org registry, product/feature catalog, entitlement ledger, policy evaluator, usage/quota adapter, billing sync, cache/invalidation, audit and migration/version layer.

## Agent tree
Contract Mapping Agent; Plan Configuration Agent; Entitlement QA Agent; Migration Agent; Usage/Quota Analyst; Support Explanation Agent; Drift/Reconciliation Agent; Incident Agent.

## Deterministic services
Subject resolution; hierarchy traversal; feature lookup; effective-date logic; quota arithmetic; credit consumption; override precedence; plan versioning; deterministic allow/deny; cache invalidation; idempotent provision/revoke; reconciliation.

## Workflow
Contract/order/billing event → map to exact plan/version → compute subject/org entitlements → persist effective/expiry/source → runtime request → resolve subject/resource → evaluate deterministic entitlement + quota → allow/deny with reason/version → consume quota if appropriate → reconcile against billing/contract changes → revoke/expire safely.

## Integrations / API / data
Billing/subscriptions, usage metering, CRM/contracts, auth/IAM, feature flags, API gateways, application backends, customer portals and analytics. Data: plans/features, accounts/orgs, grants, overrides, limits, usage references, decisions and audit.

## Monetization / distribution
MAU/accounts/orgs, entitlement checks, features/products, enterprise/private, SDK/API, premium contract/migration tooling. Distribution via SaaS developer ecosystems, billing/payment integrations and enterprise platform teams.

## Security/privacy/compliance
Fail closed on unknown subject/feature; no client-side authority; signed/server decisions, least privilege, immutable source refs, time-bound overrides, audit, revocation propagation and tenant isolation.

## Failure / edge cases
Billing lag, plan downgrade mid-cycle, grandfathered feature, overlapping enterprise contract, expired override, org merge/split, seat reassignment, offline cache, stale quota, multi-region cache drift, trial conversion, refunds, suspended account, API outage. Cache must not outlive revocation guarantees.

## Scale / overlap
App-level permissions → multi-product entitlement service → shared commercial access control plane. Overlap #4 AI permissions for agent actions, #69 billing, #95 ROI. #070 owns customer/product entitlement.

## Classification
**DESIGN NOW:** stable subject/resource/feature IDs, versioned policy, source/effective/expiry, deterministic reasons, cache invalidation and revocation.  
**BUILD NOW:** Command Center capability lifecycle/registries should use compatible entitlement/feature-flag concepts for future multi-product portfolio.  
**BUILD BEFORE FIRST COMPANY:** customer/org tenant hierarchy, commercial plan catalog, billing sync and runtime entitlement service.  
**COMPANY-SPECIFIC LATER:** customer-facing product/contract integrations.  
**SCALE-ONLY:** global edge entitlement network.

# Mandatory 24-part completion block
1. Product Tree: API/catalog/hierarchy/seats/quotas/credits/trials/overrides/grandfathering/regional/beta/developer/time-bound/admin/provision/billing/flags/audit/SDK.
2. Feature Tree: subject/org/product/plan/version/feature/scope/seat/limits/credits/effective/expiry/source/override/inheritance/decision/audit.
3. Customer Tree: SaaS/API/AI/devplatform/marketplace/enterprise/device/multi-product.
4. Vertical Tree: seats/usage AI/API/contracts/marketplaces/device fleets/multi-location/internal platforms.
5. Brain Tree: configuration/explanation only; runtime enforcement deterministic.
6. Agent Tree: contract mapping/plan config/QA/migration/usage/support/reconciliation/incident.
7. Service Tree: subject/hierarchy/feature/date/quota/credits/precedence/version/allow-deny/cache/provision/reconcile.
8. Workflow Tree: source event→plan/version→grants→runtime check→allow/deny→quota→reconcile/revoke.
9. Integration Tree: billing/metering/CRM/contracts/auth/flags/API gateways/apps/portal/analytics.
10. Data Tree: plans/features/accounts/orgs/grants/overrides/limits/usage refs/decisions/audit.
11. API Tree: evaluate/grants/plans/features/usage/reconcile/provision/revoke.
12. Monetization Tree: MAU/accounts/checks/features/products/enterprise/API/tooling.
13. Distribution Tree: SaaS dev/billing/enterprise platform/OEM.
14. Automation Tree: grant/revoke/check/quota automated; contract interpretation changes reviewed.
15. Moat Tree: contract mapping, migration tooling, low-latency correctness, integration breadth.
16. Platform Tree: entitlement API→commercial access plane→portfolio product-control infrastructure.
17. Risk Tree: over-entitlement/under-entitlement/stale cache/revocation lag/cross-tenant leak.
18. Scale Tree: app→portfolio→global edge.
19. Spinoff Tree: plan migration/feature catalog modules; usage billing stays separate.
20. Command Center Dependencies: IDs, policy, capability registry, cache, events, billing factory, tenant isolation.
21. Design-Now Requirements: reusable feature/capability entitlement schema and revocation semantics.
22. Build-Now Requirements: make Command Center capability activation/permissions compatible with future portfolio entitlements.
23. Safe-to-Defer Requirements: customer billing/contract hierarchy/edge network.
24. Autonomous Mature State: entitlement changes propagate and reconcile automatically; humans configure contracts and resolve exceptional commercial rules.

## Saturation result

# Company 071 — Webhook Reliability Platform

**Company ID:** `company:future:071`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:071`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-071-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; no customer event delivery or external endpoint mutation.

## Business identity
Purpose: make event delivery dependable through authenticated sending/receiving, retries, ordering, deduplication, replay, transformation and observable delivery evidence.

## Product tree
Inbound Webhook Gateway; Outbound Delivery Service; Signing/Verification; Endpoint Registry; Retry/Backoff; Dead-Letter Queue; Replay Console; Dedup/Idempotency; Ordering/Sequencing; Schema Registry; Event Versioning; Transform/Filter/Route; Fan-Out; Rate Limiting; Endpoint Health; Secret Rotation; Delivery Logs; Alerting; Sandbox/Event Simulation; Developer Portal; Connector/Event Marketplace; SDKs; Enterprise/Private Deployment.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree
Features: event ID/type/version, producer, tenant, payload hash, schema, sequence/partition, endpoint, signing key ref, attempt count, next retry, status, response code, latency, dedup key, retention, replay source, transform version and evidence.
Customers: SaaS, APIs, ecommerce, fintech infrastructure, marketplaces, developer platforms, integration vendors and enterprises.
Verticals: payment events, commerce/order events, identity/security events, AI/agent events, CRM/support, IoT and internal event-driven systems.

## Brain capability / architecture
Mostly deterministic. Brain may diagnose endpoint failures, recommend retry/routing changes and summarize delivery incidents. Architecture: durable event log, endpoint registry, schema/version registry, queue/scheduler, delivery workers, signer/verifier, retry policy, DLQ, idempotency store, ordering partitions, transform runtime, health/observability and secret-reference vault integration.

## Agent tree
Endpoint Health Agent; Delivery Incident Agent; Schema/Drift Agent; Retry Optimization Agent; Support/Diagnostic Agent; Connector Curator; Security QA Agent.

## Deterministic services
HMAC/signature verification; idempotency keys; ordered partitions; exponential backoff/jitter; retry ceilings; circuit breakers; DLQ; replay guards; rate limits; transform sandbox; secret rotation references; exact delivery receipts.

## Workflow
Event accepted → authenticate/validate schema → append durable event → assign partition/sequence → transform/filter → enqueue endpoint deliveries → sign/send → record response → retry with policy or DLQ → health/circuit-break as needed → operator/policy-approved replay → reconcile final status/evidence.

## Integrations / API / data
Producer apps, APIs, billing, commerce, identity, agent systems, queues/event buses, observability/SIEM. Data: events, schemas, endpoints, attempts, receipts, DLQ, health, transforms and secret references.

## Monetization / distribution
Events delivered, endpoints, retention, replay volume, transformations, enterprise/private, SDK/API and premium observability. Distribution via developer/integration ecosystems and cloud marketplaces.

## Security/privacy/compliance
Verify signatures, tenant isolate payloads, encrypt data, minimize retention, protect signing secrets, prevent SSRF/internal-address abuse, sanitize transformations, replay authorization and audit key rotations.

## Failure / edge cases
Endpoint timeout, 2xx with wrong semantics, duplicate producer event, out-of-order delivery, endpoint DNS/IP change, secret rotation overlap, schema change, poison event, replay storm, rate-limit cascade, regional outage, huge payload, receiver outage for days.

## Scale / overlap
App webhook helper → enterprise event delivery → webhook/event reliability infrastructure. Overlap Command Center event bus/outbox, #72 API drift, #73 secret rotation. #071 owns external event delivery semantics.

## Classification
**DESIGN NOW:** event IDs/versioning, idempotency, durable queue/outbox, retry/DLQ, signed receipts, secret refs, replay policy.  
**BUILD NOW:** Command Center command/event runtime should use these reliability patterns internally.  
**BUILD BEFORE FIRST COMPANY:** multi-tenant endpoint/worker platform and external developer API.
